items.item: `Sources/PDF HTML Rendering/PDF.HTML.Context+Rendering.swift`: a link to `#id` is emitted as a URI annotat
items.reason: Code is in PDF.HTML.Context.swift now. Text runs carry internalLinkId (and linkURL only for external hrefs), so swift-pdf-render's run emitter files them in pdf.link.pending; a new PDF.HTML.resolvedPages(context:) resolves them against the id destinations and is used by both render (finalizeRendering) and pages (content pages before header/footer merge). Opening an <a> now clears the other link kind so a nested fragment link inside an external one (or vice versa) is not mixed. Tests in new Tests/PDF HTML Rendering Tests/Internal Link Tests.swift cover render, pages and an external URI link.

notes: A fragment link whose id does not exist now produces no annotation (resolveInternalLinks drops it) rather than a broken URI. Internal links inside header/footer views are still not resolved, and header/footer annotations in general are not merged into pages (pre-existing; out of scope). Not built; swiftc -parse and swift format run.
